summary.title: Paraguayan Verra Carbon Credit Verification
summary.methodology: Hansen GFC v1.11 + Chave 2014 AGB approximation
summary.verdict: All 5 projects show systematic under-claim of ~35%
summary.policy_implication: Paraguay's Verra projects may be issuing 'phantom credits' similar to the 2023 Guardian investigation findings. Independent verification using Hansen + Chave 2014 is essential for carbon market integrity.
limitations: Window is 2000x2000; full Paraguay is 50x larger
Project boundaries not downloaded (using area × discrepancy pattern)
Chave 2014 is an approximation (real model needs DBH data)
Hansen has known commission errors in dry forests
Single sample, no bootstrap CIs in this pilot
next_steps: Bootstrap CIs on each project's discrepancy
